Klasse ServerBall

java.lang.Object
org.golfit.server.game.ServerBall
public class ServerBall extends Object
Represents the server-side physical state and behavior of a golf ball. Optimized to prevent tunneling via dynamic sub-stepping and continuous resolution.

  • Konstruktordetails

    • ServerBall

      public ServerBall(double px, double py)
      Creates a new server ball at the given position. Coordinates are normalized to grid units if they appear to be raw pixels.
      Parameter:
      px - the initial x position
      py - the initial y position

  • Methodendetails

    • stroke

      public void stroke(double initialVx, double initialVy)
      Applies a stroke to the ball with the given initial velocity. Saves the current position for water hazard resets and increments the stroke counter.
      Parameter:
      initialVx - the initial x velocity in grid units per second
      initialVy - the initial y velocity in grid units per second

    • update

      public void update(double deltaTime, List<MapData.ServerShape> nearbyShapes)
      Advances the ball's physics by one tick. Applies friction, performs sub-stepped movement to prevent tunneling, and resolves collisions with nearby obstacles.
      Parameter:
      deltaTime - the time step in seconds
      nearbyShapes - the obstacles to check for collision

    • resolveCollision

      private void resolveCollision()
      Resolves a detected collision by pushing the ball out and reflecting its velocity.

    • resetToLastPosition

      public void resetToLastPosition()
      Resets the ball to its last stationary position (used for water hazard resets).

    • checkCollision

      public boolean checkCollision(MapData.ServerShape shape)
      Checks whether this ball collides with the given shape. Supports rectangle, polygon, and ellipse shapes.
      Parameter:
      shape - the obstacle shape to test against
      Gibt zurück:
      true if a collision is detected

    • updateCollisionData

      private boolean updateCollisionData(double nearestX, double nearestY)
      Tests if the ball overlaps the nearest point and updates collision normal/overlap data.
      Parameter:
      nearestX - the x coordinate of the nearest point on the shape
      nearestY - the y coordinate of the nearest point on the shape
      Gibt zurück:
      true if the ball overlaps the point (collision detected)
